judge.rationale: The candidate only wrote the `.lore/dod.md` planning file, updated `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, and added an acceptance test file (`src/orchestration/usage-reporting.acceptance.test.ts`), completely omitting the actual implementation in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts`. Because `chatOrchestrator.ts` was never modified to accumulate usage across rounds, the newly added test `'reports summed usage across multiple tool rounds'` fails outright, breaking `npm test`. Furthermore, the candidate did not update the `afterModelResponse` hook signature (`usage` to `totalUsage`), did not add a `CHANGELOG.md` entry, and left the `.lore/dod.md` artifact committed in the repository. While the candidate's plan and test structure identified the right approach, stopping before implementing the production code change leaves the PR broken and incomplete.
